Introduction

The hashtag #KerjaNyataUntukRakyat ran from 15/10/2026 09:00 to 24/10/2026 06:49 GMT+7. The dataset holds 2,857 tweets from 1,899 unique accounts, with 32,364 likes, 10,033 retweets, 7,468 comments and 49,865 engagements. This report covers tweet types, the accounts with most tweets, top words and hashtags, the busiest hour, emotion labels on a subset and evidence tiers across accounts.

Findings

  • The dataset holds 2,857 tweets from 1,899 unique accounts, with 2,402 original tweets, 369 replies and 86 quotes.
  • The accounts with most tweets are pusdabbwsbs (38), pucksultra (22), BBWSCimanuk (22), MetroTV (18) and PUSDA_PENA (16).
  • Top words are tahun (1,097), program (999), indonesia (914), dua (846) and strategis (758); top hashtags are #2tahungeraknyata (744), #2tahunpemerintahprabowo (428), #geraknyataprabowogibran (417), #pu608 (354) and #kerjanyatauntukrakyat (344).
  • The busiest hour is 19/10/2026 21:00 GMT+7 with 431 tweets; the dataset records 16 burst hours.
  • Emotion labels cover 1,431 tweets, the top 50.1% by reactions: Trust 57.2%, Anticipation 36.8%, Joy 22.2%, Anger 5.8% and Disgust 4.1%; a tweet can carry several labels.
  • Evidence tiers over 1,899 accounts: T0 724, T1 320, T2 855 and T3 0.

Remarks

The dataset covers 15/10/2026 09:00 to 24/10/2026 06:49 GMT+7. Emotion labels apply to 1,431 tweets and evidence tiers apply to 1,899 accounts. Evidence tiers record signals in the dataset; they do not prove automation, payment or coordination. Watch next: periods after 24/10/2026 and account activity across the 16 burst hours.

Amplification

Source: Kestrel Parts D and E. 1,899 accounts. Tiers describe evidence found in this dataset. They are not a claim that an account is automated, paid or coordinated.

Evidence tiers

Accounts per evidence tier

T0No signals
724 accounts, 38%

Nothing in this corpus separates this account from ordinary participation.

T1Burst participation only
320 accounts, 17%

The account posted inside an amplification burst and nothing else fired. Never filtered: posting during a spike is what an interested human does too.

T2Metadata-suspicious
855 accounts, 45%

At least two independent evidence families fired (burst-exclusive posting, creation inside a creation burst, extreme profile metadata, high near-duplicate/self-repetition).

T3Coordinated
0 accounts, 0%

This account sits in a cluster that stayed outside the permutation null after FDR correction. The strongest evidence tier, and the only one the de-amplified corpus removes by default.
